facts.fact: The Central Bank of Somalia's public notice of 29 July 2025 mandates all commercial banks, from 1 September 2025, to open no new account without a valid NIRA National ID and to renew or update accounts only on confirmation of a valid NIRA ID, starting in the Banadir region.
